description: This file implements a cellular modem state machine for managing cellular interface states, device detection, registration, network start/stop, and IP configuration, including handling of system events and interactions with cellular hardware abstraction layer.

methods.name: Cellular_get_sm_ctx
methods.description: Copies the current cellular state machine context into the provided structure.

methods.name: CellularMgrDeviceRemovedStatusCBForSM
methods.description: Callback for device removal detection, updates device detection status.

methods.name: CellularMgrDeviceOpenStatusCBForSM
methods.description: Callback for device open status, updates device open status and enables cellular if online.

methods.name: CellularMgrDeviceSlotStatusCBForSM
methods.description: Callback for device slot status, updates slot info.

methods.name: cellular_get_serving_info
methods.description: Retrieves registration, roaming, and attach status.

methods.name: CellularMgrDeviceRegistrationStatusCBForSM
methods.description: Callback for device registration status updates.

methods.name: CellularMgrProfileStatusCBForSM
methods.description: Callback for profile creation status updates.

methods.name: CellularMgrIPReadyCBForSM
methods.description: Callback for IP address configuration updates, sets system events, updates interface status, and manages IP forwarding.

methods.name: CellularMgrGetNetworkRegisteredService
methods.description: Returns the network registered service type.

methods.name: CellularMgrPacketServiceStatusCBForSM
methods.description: Callback for packet service status updates.

methods.name: StateDown
methods.description: Handles the DOWN state, detects modem device presence, and transitions accordingly.

methods.name: StateDeactivated
methods.description: Handles the DEACTIVATED state, manages device opening and transitions.

methods.name: StateDeregistered
methods.description: Handles the DEREGISTERED state, manages slot selection and registration.

methods.name: StateRegistered
methods.description: Handles the REGISTERED state, manages profile creation and network start.

methods.name: StateConnected
methods.description: Handles the CONNECTED state, monitors link and IP status, manages disconnection.

methods.name: CellularMgr_ControllerInit
methods.description: Initializes the cellular state machine control structure.

methods.name: CellularMgr_StateMachine_Thread
methods.description: Main thread function for cellular state machine, runs the state transition loop.

methods.name: CellularMgr_Start_State_Machine
methods.description: Starts the cellular state machine in a new thread with given configuration.
